findings.message: "$this" can no longer be used in a plain function or method since PHP 7.1. (existing bug, not caused by the upgrade: $this outside an object fails on every PHP version)

Since PHP 7.0, functions inspecting arguments, like func_get_args(), no longer report the original value as passed to a parameter, but will instead provide the current value. The parameter "$typeName" was used, and possibly changed (by reference), on line 126. (PHP 7.0 behaviour: code that runs on PHP 7 or 8 today already gets this behaviour, so the upgrade changes nothing)

The parameter "$className" was changed on line 376. (PHP 7.0 behaviour: func_get_args() and similar report the current value of a changed parameter, and code that runs on PHP 7 or 8 today already gets this, so the upgrade changes nothing)
